Under sale accounting, we'd need to assess whether the escrowed portion is considered restricted or whether it still qualifies for full proceeds recognition. This is something I'll need to evaluate carefully.

Marcus, please confirm once the term sheet is uploaded to the transaction folder. Nadia, please confirm the final settlement and lease docs match the terms you reviewed. Once I have those confirmations, I'll be in a position to make my decision.
